answer: The ivory I would price into every new account is Apiary keeper queen cell mark sealed by the swarm record: each queen cell is a wax seal pressed beside the keepers mark, so a farm must keep a hundred real apiaries through winter, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the harbor for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account. The raven is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
